# AI Site Scan: full text

> The text of every public page of AI Site Scan (getaisitescan.com), in Markdown. Short index: https://getaisitescan.com/llms.txt

## AI Site Scan: can AI read your website?

URL: https://getaisitescan.com/

Free check, no login. See what AI sees, and what to fix first.

### What AI Site Scan checks

AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews answer questions with text they fetch from websites. Most of them read the raw HTML and do not run JavaScript. If they cannot reach, read or understand your page, they skip it or describe it wrong. This tool tests your page the way they do, in 1 to 3 seconds, and tells you what to fix first.

- **Get in.** 14 AI crawlers and assistants, from GPTBot and ClaudeBot to PerplexityBot, request your page. You see which ones get it and which ones your server or robots.txt turns away.
- **Read.** Your page without JavaScript, side by side with a real browser screenshot. If your text only appears after scripts run, AI sees an almost empty page.
- **Understand.** Titles, headings, structured data (JSON-LD), brand signals and, for local businesses, whether the page says where you are.
- **Trust and find more.** Contact details, dates, the sitemap, llms.txt and 23 agent-readiness standards, rated as a level from 0 to 5.

### Pricing

#### Free check

A score from 0 to 100, the AI view, the bot test, every issue with what the AI saw, and the top 3 fixes in full. No login.

#### Full fix guide

Every fix with steps and ready-to-paste code, filled in for your site. One Markdown file for your developer or your AI coding tool.

#### 10-site pack

The full fix guide for 10 sites, for freelancers and agencies who check client sites.

- **One-time payment** in US dollars. No subscription, nothing renews.
- **Instant delivery.** After you pay, your license key is applied here and every fix opens. Polar emails your receipt and a link to your key.
- **Secure checkout by Polar**, our merchant of record. We never see your card details.
- **7-day refund**, no questions. [Pricing details](https://getaisitescan.com/pricing) · [Refunds and delivery](https://getaisitescan.com/refund)
- **Self-serve.** The guide tells you or your developer what to change. We do not log in to your site.

### Questions

**Does a high score mean ChatGPT will cite my site?** No. The score shows how easy it is for AI tools to reach and understand your page. Whether they cite you also depends on your content and your reputation.

**Where does the score come from?** From the open-source geo-optimizer-skill engine (MIT license). It scores 9 areas for a total of 100 points. Our extra checks, such as the bot test and agent readiness, do not change the score.

**Do you store my results?** Your history stays in your own browser. Our server keeps a result for 10 minutes, so a repeat check is fast.

**What is in the full fix guide?** Every fix for your site, ranked, with the steps and ready-to-paste code filled in for your pages: JSON-LD, llms.txt, robots.txt and head tags. It is one Markdown file you can hand to a developer or an AI coding tool.

**How do I get the guide after I pay?** Right away. You pay on Polar's secure checkout and come back here. Your license key is applied and every fix opens on screen. Polar also emails you a receipt with a link to your key.

**Is it a subscription?** No. You pay once, in US dollars. Nothing renews, so there is nothing to cancel.

**Can I get a refund?** Yes. If the guide does not help, email us within 7 days of your purchase for a full refund. You do not need to give a reason.

Made by [Daniel Rojansky](https://getaisitescan.com/about) in Israel. Updated Nov 27, 2026. Also see the [llms.txt checker](https://getaisitescan.com/llms-txt) and the [AI robots.txt checker](https://getaisitescan.com/ai-robots-txt).

## About AI Site Scan

URL: https://getaisitescan.com/about

AI Site Scan shows how AI tools see a website. You enter an address, and in 1 to 3 seconds you get an AI readiness score from 0 to 100, the page as an AI tool reads it, a test of 14 AI bots, and a ranked list of fixes.

### Who makes it

AI Site Scan is made and run by Daniel Rojansky, an independent product and technology consultant in Israel (trade name: Daniel Consulting). It is a small, independent product. See the [contact page](https://getaisitescan.com/contact) for business details.

### How the score works

- The score comes from the open-source [geo-optimizer-skill](https://github.com/auriti-labs/geo-optimizer-skill) engine (MIT license). It scores 9 areas, such as robots.txt, structured data, content and brand signals, for a total of 100 points.
- AI Site Scan adds its own checks: a test of 14 AI crawlers and assistants, 23 agent-readiness standards, page speed and size, headings, links and a location check for local businesses. These extra checks do not change the score.
- The checks are rules in code. The fix guide is built from your results by the same rules. No AI model writes it.
- A higher score means AI tools find the page easier to read. It does not promise citations or rankings.

### How we make money

The check is free. We sell one product: the full fix guide, as a one-time payment of $19 for 1 site or $49 for 10 sites. There are no ads on the site, and we do not sell data. See [Pricing](https://getaisitescan.com/pricing).

### What the scan keeps

Your scan history stays in your own browser. Our server keeps a result for 10 minutes so a repeat check is fast, and short-term logs. See the [privacy policy](https://getaisitescan.com/privacy) for details.

### Contact

Email support@getaisitescan.com.

If you do not get your key within 15 minutes, check your spam folder, then email support@getaisitescan.com. We will send it to you.

There is no subscription, so there is nothing to cancel. If you bought by mistake, ask for a refund.

- You get a full refund. You do not need to give a reason.
- We refund through Polar to the payment method you used. Your bank may need 5 to 10 business days to show it.
- After a refund, the license key stops working.
- After 7 days, we still refund you if we could not deliver the guide, or if it does not work because of a fault on our side.

### Before you dispute a charge

Please email us first. We answer fast, and a refund from us is quicker than a dispute with your bank.

## Terms of service

URL: https://getaisitescan.com/terms

### 1. Who we are

AI Site Scan (getaisitescan.com) is run by Daniel Rojansky, a sole trader registered in Israel, trading as Daniel Consulting ("we", "us"). Contact: support@getaisitescan.com. These terms apply when you use the site or buy the full fix guide.

### 2. The service

The check is free. It tests public web pages and shows how AI tools can reach, read and understand them. The full fix guide is a paid digital product. It lists every fix for a site, with steps and ready-to-paste code. A license key unlocks it.

To test access for AI tools, the scanner requests the page you enter with the user agent names that those tools publish. It also reads public files such as robots.txt, sitemap.xml and llms.txt. It reads only public pages. It does not log in, and it does not get past paywalls or other access controls.

### 3. Fair use

Check your own sites, or sites you have permission to test. Do not use the scanner to overload, attack or probe a site, or to check many sites in bulk with scripts. We limit how often one visitor can scan, and we may block traffic that looks like abuse.

### 4. Prices and payment

Prices are on the [pricing page](https://getaisitescan.com/pricing), in US dollars. Each purchase is a one-time payment. There is no subscription.

Polar Software, Inc. ("Polar") is our merchant of record and authorized reseller. When you buy, you buy the guide from Polar, and Polar's [Buyer Terms](https://polar.sh/legal/checkout-buyer-terms) also apply. Polar takes the payment, adds sales tax or VAT where it applies, and sends your receipt. Your right to use the guide comes from these terms. We never see or store your card details.

### 5. Delivery

Delivery is digital and instant. After payment, your license key is applied on the site and the guide unlocks. Polar also emails you a receipt with a link to your key. Nothing is shipped. Details are on the [Refunds and delivery](https://getaisitescan.com/refund) page.

### 6. Your license key

Each purchase gives you one license key. The single-site key unlocks the guide for 1 site. The 10-site key unlocks it for 10 sites. One site is one host name, such as example.com. Keys do not expire. You may use the guide and its code on the sites you unlocked, for yourself or for your clients. Do not share, publish or resell the key or the guide. We may disable a key that is shared or abused.

### 7. Refunds and cancellation

You can get a full refund within 7 days of your purchase. There is nothing to cancel, because nothing renews. Details are on the [Refunds and delivery](https://getaisitescan.com/refund) page.

### 8. No guarantee

The score and the fixes come from an automated tool. They do not promise that AI tools or search engines will read, cite or rank a site, or that traffic will grow. Check each fix, and back up your site, before you change it.

### 9. Availability

We work to keep the site running, but we cannot promise that it is always available or free of errors. We may change, add or remove features. If we stop selling the guide, a guide you already downloaded stays yours.

### 10. Ownership

Your site and its content stay yours. We use what we fetch only to make your report. The site, our code and the text of the guide belong to us, except the open-source scoring engine (MIT license), which belongs to its authors.

### 11. Liability

As far as the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, such as lost profits or lost data, and our total liability to you is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim. Nothing in these terms limits a liability that the law does not let us limit.

### 12. Sanctions

You may not use or buy from AI Site Scan if you are in a country, or on a list, under US, EU, UK or Israeli sanctions. Polar may also block payments from some countries.

### 13. Changes to these terms

We may update these terms. The date at the top shows the last change. A change does not affect a purchase you made before it.

### 14. Law

Israeli law applies, and the courts of the Tel Aviv district have jurisdiction. If you are a consumer, you keep the rights that the law where you live gives you and that cannot be waived.

### 15. Contact

Email support@getaisitescan.com.

## Privacy policy

URL: https://getaisitescan.com/privacy

### Who is responsible

Daniel Rojansky, trading as Daniel Consulting, Israel, is responsible for your data. Contact: support@getaisitescan.com.

### What we collect and why

- **Addresses you check.** We fetch the page you enter, and some public files of that site, to make your report. The result stays in a server cache for 10 minutes. Server logs keep the site, the score and the time for a short time.
- **Scan history.** It stays only in your browser. You can delete it in the History tab.
- **License key and unlocked sites.** If you buy, your browser keeps your license key and the sites you unlocked, so you do not have to paste the key again. To check a key, we send it and the site name to Polar.
- **Your email, if you give it.** We use it to send your report and, if you ask, one reminder. Emails go out through Resend. We do not add you to a newsletter.
- **Messages you send us.** We keep them to answer you and to keep a record of support requests.
- **Analytics.** PostHog records page views, clicks and scan steps, so we can improve the product. Until you accept cookies, it stores nothing in your browser. If you accept, it keeps an ID in a cookie and in local storage. Session recordings hide what you type.
- **Advertising.** Only if you accept cookies, Google Ads measures whether a visit from an ad led to a purchase.
- **Payments.** Polar processes payments as our merchant of record. We receive your name, email, country and what you bought. We never see your card details.

### Legal bases

We use your data to give you what you asked for, such as a report or a purchase (contract). We use analytics and advertising cookies, and send a reminder email, only with your consent. We keep short server logs to protect the service from abuse (legitimate interest).

### Who processes it

These service providers process data for us, each under its own data protection terms: Vercel (hosting), PostHog (analytics), Resend (email), Polar (payments, as merchant of record) and Google (ads, only with your consent). They may process data in the United States, the European Union and other countries. We do not sell your data, and we do not share it for other companies' marketing.

### How long we keep it

- Scan results: 10 minutes in the server cache.
- Server logs: a few days at most.
- Your email for reports: until you ask us to delete it.
- Support messages: up to 2 years.
- Purchase records: as long as tax and accounting law requires. Polar keeps the payment records as merchant of record.

### Cookies and browser storage

**Always on, because the site needs them:** your scan history, your cookie choice, and, if you bought, your license key and unlocked sites. These stay in your browser's local storage and are not sent to anyone, except the key and site name when we check a key with Polar.

**Only after you accept:** PostHog analytics (a cookie and a local storage ID) and Google Ads conversion cookies. To change your choice, clear this site's data in your browser and choose again.

### Your rights

You can ask for a copy of your data, ask us to correct or delete it, or object to how we use it. You can withdraw your consent at any time. Email support@getaisitescan.com, and we will reply within 30 days. You can also complain to your data protection authority. In Israel, that is the Privacy Protection Authority.

### Children

AI Site Scan is for website owners and businesses. It is not meant for children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect their data.

### Security

The whole site uses HTTPS. We keep as little data as we can. Card details go only to Polar's checkout.

### Changes

We post every change on this page and update the date at the top.
